title: Audit visual containment and overflow
description: Audit whether inputs, labels, icons, sliders, selects, chips, rows, and admin/editor previews respect their containers across orientations and widths.
objective: Find component-level and shared-layout overflow risks before adding more controls.
inputs_required: Guilherme screenshot showing inputs passing the visual boundary
expected_outputs: List of selectors that can overflow their parent
List of controls that need width, max-width, box-sizing, flex-wrap, or min-width safeguards
Recommended mechanical tests for overflow and clipping
acceptance_criteria: The report covers every filter type and shared modules, not only Range inputs.
The report distinguishes obvious mechanical overflow from nuanced visual craft that requires Guilherme QA.
Each finding references the selector, source file, likely cause, and recommended fix category.
verification: Static CSS/markup findings cite source paths.
No implementation changes are made by this task.

budgets.context_budget: CSS selectors, widget render markup, prior screenshots
budgets.research_budget: local code and optional punctual screenshot checks

risks: Adding deeper controls before containment is stable can multiply visual regressions.
